reply.emotion: steady and functional, marking the progression of the day
notes: The noun часы is always plural in form, even when referring to a single clock or a single watch.
Do not confuse with час (hour), which is singular.

senses.definition: An instrument for measuring and showing time, designed to be hung on a wall or placed on a piece of furniture.

examples.translation: New wall clock hangs on the wall.
examples.emotion: observing the new room arrangement calmly

senses.definition: A small timepiece worn on the wrist or carried in a pocket.

examples.text: Он посмотрел на свои наручные часы.
examples.emotion: checking the time quickly before leaving
